name: Rail elbow: J2 is a curved rail on link 1, link 2 a carriage beside the arm-end hub
verdict: dead: best honest gap 71.15 vs champion 68.93 (spec rigid rail 77.7-92.2); not worth a GPU sweep - the rail is metal over the whole ~140 deg J2 travel and a rigid carriage makes it one radius about p2: rail parts 0 % in band in every low-contact config
note: Bench(60,160) fast grid, kit checks (march, dense K2, K6, audit clean); best = 2-stage geared telescopic rail, champion axes, d_off -40, rail parts laid out at their fitted radius (r_lay 142.5); same config sampled at 70 mm read 69.51 (flattering). Spec changes: strap 1 to the rail END, rail = carriage travel + ends. Ti 152 g.
limiter: rail beyond the carriage: per-pose rail need p50 83 / p95 208 / max >220 mm vs 62-86 mm between fixing end and carriage (abduction 90-105 deg, pose 90 plane -15 elev 75 axial -45 sets it); telescoping removes that part but each rigid stage is one radius (116-145 mm over skin at 50-60) = 44 % of samples at 0 % in band; cam track puts the rail 45 % in band but 23 % contact
